t_advice_summary_textbox.text: recite out loud the colours that seem to be doing well and switch it up when scores start to differ

vb_textbox.text: I would say the colour out loud if it scored well. Or you could say the colours which do not perform well. Like just say them out loud like "pink, blue, orange" and it should help a little. Also remember to press space for the second bit cause i forgot a few times :( but you should do fine and remember that a certain colour won't always perform well, it'll change. Don't stress too much about remembering if you're struggling you'll be fine
